newsitem.title: USA: Valley comfortable with EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: Valley comfortable with EPS estimates.

text.p: Valley National Gases Inc is on track to meet analysts' earnings estimates of $0.09 per share for the fiscal 1998 first quarter and $0.46 for the full year, President and Chief Executive Officer Larry Bandi said in an interview.
"We're very comfortable with those numbers," Bandi told Reuters. "Things are going well...I don't see anything that concerns me at this point."
The company's first quarter ends September 30, and the fiscal year closes June 30, 1998.

Valley National Gases, headquartered in Wheeling, W.Va., is a packager and distributor of industrial, medical and specialty gases, propane, as well as welding equipment and supplies, in 10 states in the Middle Atlantic and Midwest.
The company, founded in 1958, went public last April with an initial offering of two million shares.
Earnings in fiscal 1997 were $0.33 per share before special non-cash charges.
